title: About Clinamen Basin Section
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 528 recent saved-signal files and 159 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @jonaasw1: NYC is getting an insane exhibit this week. It's called "Clinamen." It's a living,... and Anchor image material 2, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Clinamen Basin Section: Architectural section, low wide camera: a cropped electric-turquoise basin spills off the lower frame, filled with receding white ceramic apertures and collision shadows. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against large glowing oval diffuser underside, dominant turquoise basin plane, and rear cropped turquoise pool cut.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
